title: AI 2 round 2 is live: the box at the top is one line, and you can talk into a card.

text: The composer went from 277 pixels to 79 and cannot grow - the mic is inside the box, and the engine words fold behind a small dots button that opens over the page. Press New card and it opens an empty card that starts listening; everything you say goes into that card, into a transcript pinned along its bottom where the words stay put. Every row now says who it came from, with your own words marked. Nothing goes read when you click it any more.
